name: Ningaloo Coast
description: Ningaloo Coast lies on Western Australia's remote northwest shore, about 1,200 kilometres north of Perth. Its 260-kilometre reef runs so close to land that you can wade in from the beach and snorkel among corals. Whale sharks gather here each year, sea turtles are plentiful, and beneath the dry limestone country behind the coast lies a hidden network of caves and underground streams.
